rationale: Review all21 declarations, both parameter tables and actual launch/read/list/terminal handlers, parser/spec/help/format/scoping contracts. Replace duplicated formatter fixtures with real writer output, isolate environment/exit/console state, route scope RPCs independently and exercise actual flag validation. Retain all24 runtime controls with fewer lines; temporary warning mutation distinguishes old/new coverage. Final integration uses an actual RuntimeClient instance with a stubbed call method and complete checked handler context, removing unsafe context casts.

cases.title: passes the complete supported creation contract and retry receipt
cases.reason: Retain exact workerStart mapping of all creation flags and retry receipt id; explicit coordinator avoids identity lookup and successful state leaves the exit code unset.

cases.title: capability-gates and forwards per-invocation launch preferences
cases.reason: Retain ordered runtime capability probe before forwarding per-invocation model/effort; mutation must be the second request with the chosen agent and preferences.

cases.title: forwards --spec without a task for atomic creation
cases.reason: Retain atomic --spec creation without --task at the actual workerStart request boundary.

cases.title: fails before worker-start when the runtime would strip launch preferences
cases.reason: An older host with no launch-preference capability must reject before mutation; exactly one status probe is allowed.

cases.title: sets an unsuccessful exit code for failed and unknown receipts
cases.reason: Retain unknown receipt exit-1 control; rename the reviewed title to unknown only and independently check the failed receipt exit in the existing refused-start case.

cases.title: renders %s recovery commands through the resolved %s executable
cases.reason: Require one fresh real writer/console call; verify resolved nextCommands in the actual receipt and printed plain output, removing the unchecked cast and preserving both executable/format rows.

parameter_inputs.reason: JSON recovery receipt uses dev executable and unknown exit state.
Plain recovery output uses Linux packaged alias and must show resolved next command.

cases.title: prints the host error for a refused worker start
cases.reason: Observe the host lastError through actual console output rather than reconstructed formatter data; also assert failed state sets exit 1.

cases.title: prints a reveal warning for a live background worker
cases.reason: Observe the reveal warning through the actual response-to-writer path. The original suite passes when the handler drops warning; the reviewed case fails, with all other cases passing.

cases.title: states the worker mode that actually ran, so a fallback is never silent
cases.reason: Assert actual printed fallback mode detail from the host receipt; remove duplicated fixture and formatter cast that bypassed handler data flow.

cases.title: prints the retained-process warning for a manual worker-stop
cases.reason: Assert actual printed retained-process warning from workerStop; remove reconstructed receipt and unchecked formatter cast.

cases.title: allows the initial zero cursor when paging worker output
cases.reason: Retain initial string zero cursor normalization to number 0 with explicit limit at the workerRead wire boundary.

cases.title: passes opaque source-pinned cursors and explicit source selection
cases.reason: Retain opaque cursor unchanged and explicit transcript source at workerRead; numeric coercion would corrupt pinned opaque cursor semantics.

cases.title: formats a legacy worker-list response without projection or page fields
cases.reason: Give bound-Run lookup a real distinct no-current-Run envelope and assert legacy worker row through actual output; preserve absent projection/page compatibility.

cases.title: passes a truncation warning to the receipt and still prints the cursor hint
cases.reason: Select actual plain output and check its warning/cursor; retain receipt warning preservation and return the worker response only to workerList, never runCurrent.

cases.title: fails closed when an older runtime strips explicit %s semantics
cases.reason: Each explicit modern flag must reject a page-less old-host result without output or enumeration retry. Return real no-current-Run response for scope probe, keeping three independent flag rows.

parameter_inputs.reason: Remote opt-in cannot silently degrade to local-only enumeration on old hosts.
An explicit limit cannot be silently ignored by an old host.
An explicit opaque cursor cannot be silently ignored by an old host.

cases.title: prints each projected row with its literal next-action argv
cases.reason: Read live/released projected rows and literal next-action argv from actual printed output; remove captured formatter casts and feed scope lookup a distinct valid envelope.

cases.title: prints partial host warnings alongside worker rows
cases.reason: Observe remote worker row plus exact partial-host warning in actual printed output, preserving environment identity, error code and dispatch identity.

cases.title: prints partial host warnings when no worker rows are available
cases.reason: Observe actual empty-worker output and its partial-host warning, preserving fallback scope and empty dispatch list wording.

cases.title: preserves partial host errors in JSON output
cases.reason: Keep exact JSON writer receipt/format control while routing scope and workerList mocks separately, preventing malformed scope fixtures from silently falling back.

cases.title: parses, forwards, and documents the remote fleet opt-in
cases.reason: Parse and validate the real remote opt-in and pass those parsed flags to the handler. Retain help, forwarding and default-omission controls while removing copied BOOLEAN_FLAGS/allowedFlags inventories.

cases.title: keeps cleanup and retention TTL controls off the public CLI surface
cases.reason: Invoke real command/flag validation for unsupported cleanup, until and policy with a valid retain control; pass parsed retain flags to actual handler instead of asserting copied spec inventories.
